deploy-bot: :rocket: Created release tag rc/2.3.1-20260320 for repo:infra-service
deploy-bot: Commit: 8f3a9b2, pipeline: https://ci.internal/pipe/4242, artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/infra/2.3.1

maria (release-eng): Pushing the short changelog here — small perf fixes and a retry backoff for db calls. No schema changes.

sam (backend): quick note — this includes the hotfix for request queue stall (8f3a9b2). I verified local smoke runs.

jen (qa): I'll kick off the staging smoke now. ETA ~12m.

ci-bot: Staging pipeline started: job/infra-staging/4242 — tests: unit, integration, smoke

akash (sre): Can we keep a 30m canary window in prod after rollout? Would like to watch p95 latencies and request error rate. If anything >2% for 5m, plan to rollback.

maria (release-eng): ack. Target rollout: 03:10 UTC deploy window. Canary 30m, then full ramp if green. Pinning prod image tag to rc/2.3.1-20260320 at deploy time.

sam (backend): For pinning: run `kubectl set image deploy/infra infra=registry.redwood/infra:rc-2.3.1-20260320 --record` — I'll prepare the k8s patch and a rollback snippet.

maria (release-eng): paste rollback snippet in thread once ready please. Also tagging release notes w/decision tree for rollback.

sam (backend): Rollback snippet: ```
# rollback to previous stable
kubectl set image deploy/infra infra=registry.redwood/infra:stable-2.3.0 --record
kubectl rollout status deploy/infra
```

jen (qa): Staging smoke passed (0 failures). Attaching quick diff with suspicious latency spike in one test but unrelated.

ci-bot: Staging pipeline succeeded: job/infra-staging/4242 — duration: 9m 34s

akash (sre): I'll start the canary rollout at T+0 and monitor. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/p95/infra, alerting set to notify #incidents if breach.

maria (release-eng): Thanks. I'll update the release notes summary for the docs team and slack post. Changelog brief: - Fix: request queue backpressure fix (reduces  tail latency) - Fix: DB client retry backoff - Ops: improved healthcheck for warmup

sam (backend): One more note — this build includes a change to the KV client; if any errors surface, we should toggle kv-client.experimental=false via feature flags as an immediate mitigation.

akash (sre): Noted. I'll stand by to flip flags if alerts fire.

maria (release-eng): All set. Deploy begins at 03:10 UTC. Will post final status here when canary completes or if rollback occurs. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Rollout started: rc/2.3.1-20260320 -> infra-prod (canary subset) at 1782359400
